subject.title: fix(autoreview): allow safe Python runtime references

question: Is the branch’s narrowly enumerated Python runtime-reference allowlist sufficiently fail-closed to become part of autoreview’s secret-scanning boundary?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well tested, but accepting new scanner exemptions is a security-boundary judgment that test success alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept after owner review
options.body: Have the autoreview owner inspect the accepted AST and token shapes, then merge while preserving the full negative corpus and downstream replay evidence.

options.title: Require broader adversarial proof
options.body: Pause merge until an independent fuzz or representative Python corpus replay demonstrates that misleading and hardcoded secret assignments remain blocked.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner review
recommendation.body: Have the autoreview owner inspect the accepted AST and token shapes, then merge while preserving the full negative corpus and downstream replay evidence.
